잠언 9:1.content: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:

잠언 9:2.content: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.

잠언 9:3.content: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,

잠언 9:4.content: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

잠언 9:5.content: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

잠언 9:6.content: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

잠언 9:7.content: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

잠언 9:8.content: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

잠언 9:9.content: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

잠언 9:10.content: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

잠언 9:11.content: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

잠언 9:12.content: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

잠언 9:13.content: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

잠언 9:14.content: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

잠언 9:15.content: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

잠언 9:16.content: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

잠언 9:17.content: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

잠언 9:18.content: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
